dialogues.jp: 今日は、珍しくひとりで帰っていた。
dialogues.en: Unusually, I was heading home alone, today.
dialogues.text: Unusually, I was heading home alone, today.

dialogues.jp:
というのも、アリスがちょっと居残りがあるか
らという理由からだった。
dialogues.en: Alice had some reason or other to stay behind at school.
dialogues.text: Alice had some reason or other to stay behind at school.

dialogues.jp:
まあ、たまにはひとりでのんびり帰るのも悪く
ないけど。
dialogues.en:
Well, it's not a bad thing to go home alone every now and
then, anyway.
dialogues.text:
Well, it's not a bad thing to go home alone every now and
then, anyway.

dialogues.jp:
俺は、バナナンボーでチョコバナナを買い、そ
れをもしゃもしゃとかじりながら歩いた。
dialogues.en:
With a chocolate banana in hand, I muched and walked in
tandem.
dialogues.text:
With a chocolate banana in hand, I muched and walked in
tandem.

dialogues.speaker: Sakura
dialogues.jp: 「お兄ーちゃん」
dialogues.en: "Oniiii-chan!"
dialogues.text: "Oniiii-chan!"

dialogues.speaker: Sakura
dialogues.jp: 「ん、そ、その声は！」
dialogues.en: "T, that voice!"
dialogues.text: "T, that voice!"

dialogues.jp:
と振り返った瞬間に、黄色い髪のちびっ子が首
根っこに飛びついてきた。
dialogues.en:
I managed to turn around, just in time to see a blonde blur
reach for my neck.
dialogues.text:
I managed to turn around, just in time to see a blonde blur
reach for my neck.

dialogues.speaker: Sakura
dialogues.jp: 「あにょーん、ひっさしぶりィ！」
dialogues.en: "Ani-yooon, long time no see!"
dialogues.text: "Ani-yooon, long time no see!"

dialogues.speaker: Sakura
dialogues.jp: 「ぐッ、苦しいッ、離れろ……ッ」
dialogues.en: "L, let go, I, can't, breathe..."
dialogues.text: "L, let go, I, can't, breathe..."

dialogues.speaker: Sakura
dialogues.jp:
「にゃー、久しぶりだから、もうちょっとくっ
　ついていたいんだけどなぁ」
dialogues.en:
"Nyaa, it's been so long since we've seen each other, you
could be more friendly!"
dialogues.text:
"Nyaa, it's been so long since we've seen each other, you
could be more friendly!"

dialogues.speaker: Sakura
dialogues.jp: 「よせッ、世間の人々が誤解する！」
dialogues.en: "Stop it, people will misunderstand!"
dialogues.text: "Stop it, people will misunderstand!"

dialogues.speaker: Sakura
dialogues.jp: 「誤解してもイイよぉ。パパー」
dialogues.en: "A misunderstanding is fine too, papa!"
dialogues.text: "A misunderstanding is fine too, papa!"

dialogues.speaker: Sakura
dialogues.jp: 「パパ、はやめろッ！」
dialogues.en: "Don't call me papa!"
dialogues.text: "Don't call me papa!"

dialogues.speaker: Sakura
dialogues.jp: 「おじさまぁー！」
dialogues.en: "Oji-sama~!"
dialogues.text: "Oji-sama~!"

dialogues.speaker: Sakura
dialogues.jp: 「おじさまもやめろッ！」
dialogues.en: "Not that either!"
dialogues.text: "Not that either!"

dialogues.speaker: Sakura
dialogues.jp: 「じゃあ、なんて呼べばいいのかわかんないよ」
dialogues.en: "Then, I don't know what would be good to call you!"
dialogues.text: "Then, I don't know what would be good to call you!"

dialogues.speaker: Sakura
dialogues.jp: 「普通にしろ、普通に」
dialogues.en: "Just call me normally, sheesh!"
dialogues.text: "Just call me normally, sheesh!"

dialogues.speaker: Sakura
dialogues.jp: 「ちぇ、つまんないなぁ。せっかく会えたのに」
dialogues.en: "Psh, how boring. After so long, as well."
dialogues.text: "Psh, how boring. After so long, as well."

dialogues.jp:
さくらは、ようやく俺の首から手を離し、地面
に足をつける。
dialogues.en:
Sakura finally let go of my neck, falling gracefully onto
the floor.
dialogues.text:
Sakura finally let go of my neck, falling gracefully onto
the floor.

dialogues.jp: 「ったく、このちびっ子が」
dialogues.en: "Sheesh, you midget..."
dialogues.text: "Sheesh, you midget..."

dialogues.speaker: Sakura
dialogues.jp:
「だから、人の身体的特徴をけなすのは、よく
　ないって言ってるでしょ？」
dialogues.en:
"You shouldn't be so careless about people's height, you
know?"
dialogues.text:
"You shouldn't be so careless about people's height, you
know?"

dialogues.jp:
俺はチョコバナナをがつがつとたいらげ、近く
のゴミ箱に、棒を捨てる。
dialogues.en: I finished up the chocolate banana, throwing away the stick.
dialogues.text: I finished up the chocolate banana, throwing away the stick.

dialogues.jp:
「で、どうしたんだ？　先月、やることがある
　だの、家を空けるだの、いろいろ言ってただ
　ろ？」
dialogues.en:
"Anyway, what happened? Didn't you talk so much last month
about having things to do, moving out for awhile, et
cetera?"
dialogues.text:
"Anyway, what happened? Didn't you talk so much last month
about having things to do, moving out for awhile, et
cetera?"

dialogues.speaker: Sakura
dialogues.jp:
「うん、ちょっとだけ一段落ついたから、あい
　さつしに来たんだよ」
dialogues.en: "Yep, I got a short break, so I came back!"
dialogues.text: "Yep, I got a short break, so I came back!"

dialogues.speaker: Sakura
dialogues.jp: 「……家で待ってろよ」
dialogues.en: "...Your house is waiting for you."
dialogues.text: "...Your house is waiting for you."

dialogues.speaker: Sakura
dialogues.jp:
「うにゅ、少しでも早くお兄ちゃんに会いたかっ
　たんだよぅ」
dialogues.en: "Unya, I wanted to see you for awhile~"
dialogues.text: "Unya, I wanted to see you for awhile~"

dialogues.speaker: Sakura
dialogues.jp:
「まあ、いいや。俺んちに帰ろう。音夢はいな
　いけど、今晩は一緒に飯でも食おう」
dialogues.en:
"Hah, oh well. Let's head back to my house. Nemu's not
around anymore, so we can have dinner together."
dialogues.text:
"Hah, oh well. Let's head back to my house. Nemu's not
around anymore, so we can have dinner together."

dialogues.speaker: Sakura
dialogues.jp:
「ううん。この後、またすぐ出かけなきゃいけ
　ないんだ。ごめんね」
dialogues.en: "Ehh. I can't, I'll have to go back after this. Sorry!"
dialogues.text: "Ehh. I can't, I'll have to go back after this. Sorry!"

dialogues.speaker: Sakura
dialogues.jp: 「そっか……。また寂しくなるな」
dialogues.en: "I see... it'd be lonely again."
dialogues.text: "I see... it'd be lonely again."

dialogues.speaker: Sakura
dialogues.jp:
「あっれぇ？　さっきはボクのこと、邪険にし
　てたくせに」
dialogues.en: "Huuuh? You used to be so cruel to me before."
dialogues.text: "Huuuh? You used to be so cruel to me before."

dialogues.speaker: Sakura
dialogues.jp: 「アレはアレ。コレはコレ」
dialogues.en: "That was then, now is now."
dialogues.text: "That was then, now is now."

dialogues.speaker: Sakura
dialogues.jp: 「袖振り合うも多生の縁！」
dialogues.en: "I'd measure your honesty with your sleeve!"
dialogues.text: "I'd measure your honesty with your sleeve!"

dialogues.speaker: Sakura
dialogues.jp: 「ワケわかんねぇ」
dialogues.en: "Incomprehensible to the max."
dialogues.text: "Incomprehensible to the max."

dialogues.jp:
相変わらず、さくらのヤツはところどころが掴
みにくい。
dialogues.en: As usual, she held on to my arm tightly.
dialogues.text: As usual, she held on to my arm tightly.

dialogues.speaker: Sakura
dialogues.jp: 「ところで、お兄ちゃん」
dialogues.en: "By the way, onii-chan."
dialogues.text: "By the way, onii-chan."

dialogues.speaker: Sakura
dialogues.jp: 「なんだ？」
dialogues.en: "What is it?"
dialogues.text: "What is it?"

dialogues.speaker: Sakura
dialogues.jp: 「体育館裏のロスキルラベンダーどうなった？」
dialogues.en: "How's the Roskill Lavender behind the gym been?"
dialogues.text: "How's the Roskill Lavender behind the gym been?"

dialogues.speaker: Sakura
dialogues.jp:
「……全部ダメになったよ。先月嵐があったろ？
　あれで、全部折れちまった」
dialogues.en:
"...It's hopeless. There was a storm last month, you know?
It was ripped up completely from that..."
dialogues.text:
"...It's hopeless. There was a storm last month, you know?
It was ripped up completely from that..."

dialogues.speaker: Sakura
dialogues.jp: 「ううん、その嵐の後だよ」
dialogues.en: "Noo, I mean after the storm."
dialogues.text: "Noo, I mean after the storm."

dialogues.speaker: Sakura
dialogues.jp: 「だから、全部ダメになったって……」
dialogues.en: "Like I said, it's hopeless..."
dialogues.text: "Like I said, it's hopeless..."

dialogues.speaker: Sakura
dialogues.jp: 「あ、そうか。まだ見に行ってないんだ……」
dialogues.en: "Ah, I see. So you haven't gone to see it..."
dialogues.text: "Ah, I see. So you haven't gone to see it..."

dialogues.speaker: Sakura
dialogues.jp: 「どういうことだ？」
dialogues.en: "What do you mean?"
dialogues.text: "What do you mean?"

dialogues.speaker: Sakura
dialogues.jp: 「えーと、あの、怒らないで聞いて」
dialogues.en: "...Err... don't get mad when you hear it!"
dialogues.text: "...Err... don't get mad when you hear it!"

dialogues.speaker: Sakura
dialogues.jp: 「怒らないよ……って、さてはなにかやったな」
dialogues.en: "I won't get mad... now tell me what the hell you did."
dialogues.text: "I won't get mad... now tell me what the hell you did."

dialogues.jp: じろりとさくらを｛にら／睨｝む。
dialogues.en: I glared at her menacingly.
dialogues.text: I glared at her menacingly.

dialogues.speaker: Sakura
dialogues.jp: 「あにゅぅ、ぶたないでぇ。ぶたないでぇ」
dialogues.en: "Anyuu, scary, scary!"
dialogues.text: "Anyuu, scary, scary!"

dialogues.jp:
さくらが頭を抱えて、縮こまる。この構図は社
会的に問題を巻き起こしてしまう。
dialogues.en:
She covered her head with her hands, turning away from me in
mock fear. If anyone were to see this scene...
dialogues.text:
She covered her head with her hands, turning away from me in
mock fear. If anyone were to see this scene...

dialogues.jp:
「そ、その世間に誤解を招くような言い方はよ
　せッ。怒らず聞いてやるから」
dialogues.en:
"S, stop inviting stupid misunderstandings already. I won't
get mad, really."
dialogues.text:
"S, stop inviting stupid misunderstandings already. I won't
get mad, really."

dialogues.jp: さくらは、ぺろりと舌を出し、ニヒヒと笑う。
dialogues.en: She giggled, sticking her tongue out at me.
dialogues.text: She giggled, sticking her tongue out at me.

dialogues.speaker: Sakura
dialogues.jp:
「あのね、ボクね、あのロスキルラベンダーが
　どうしても気になっちゃってさ」
dialogues.en:
"You know, about that Roskill Lavender, I couldn't stop
thinking about it."
dialogues.text:
"You know, about that Roskill Lavender, I couldn't stop
thinking about it."

dialogues.speaker: Sakura
dialogues.jp: 「１本だけ研究用にしばらく借りちゃった」
dialogues.en:
"So I cut off a stalk with a leaf from it, for research
purposes."
dialogues.text:
"So I cut off a stalk with a leaf from it, for research
purposes."

dialogues.speaker: Sakura
dialogues.jp: 「な、なぬぅ！」
dialogues.en: "W, what!?"
dialogues.text: "W, what!?"

dialogues.speaker: Sakura
dialogues.jp:
「だ、だから、研究が終わった後は、元のとこ
　ろに返しておいたんだよぅ」
dialogues.en:
"B, but, after I finished researching it, I replanted it at
it's original location!"
dialogues.text:
"B, but, after I finished researching it, I replanted it at
it's original location!"

dialogues.speaker: Sakura
dialogues.jp: 「元のところに返した……って、体育館裏か？」
dialogues.en: "It's old location... you mean, behind the gym?"
dialogues.text: "It's old location... you mean, behind the gym?"

dialogues.speaker: Sakura
dialogues.jp: 「そうだよ、他のどこに返すのさ」
dialogues.en: "Of course. Where else could I return it?"
dialogues.text: "Of course. Where else could I return it?"

dialogues.speaker: Sakura
dialogues.jp: 「あ……、嵐の後にか？」
dialogues.en: "Ah.... and this was after the storm?"
dialogues.text: "Ah.... and this was after the storm?"

dialogues.speaker: Sakura
dialogues.jp:
「そうだよ。だから、今どうなってるかなぁと
　思ってさ」
dialogues.en: "Yep! That's why I was wondering how it was doing."
dialogues.text: "Yep! That's why I was wondering how it was doing."

dialogues.jp: ロスキルラベンダーが、まだ残ってる！
dialogues.en: There's still a Roskill Lavender left!
dialogues.text: There's still a Roskill Lavender left!

dialogues.jp: まさか、あの嵐の前にさくらが……。
dialogues.en: Just maybe, by doing that before the storm, Sakura has...
dialogues.text: Just maybe, by doing that before the storm, Sakura has...

dialogues.jp:
俺の心臓が、やけに速く鳴っているのが聞こえ
てくる。
dialogues.en: My heart started racing at the thought.
dialogues.text: My heart started racing at the thought.

dialogues.jp:
さくらが『想定してたのより、随分と強く育っ
ていたから、もしかしたら……』という言葉が
耳を｛かす／掠｝める。
dialogues.en:
Sakura's continued explanation, on how "it might grow with
lots and lots of care and attention", flew right over my
head.
dialogues.text:
Sakura's continued explanation, on how "it might grow with
lots and lots of care and attention", flew right over my
head.

dialogues.jp: あの花が……。アリスの花が……。
dialogues.en: That flower is... Alice's flower is...
dialogues.text: That flower is... Alice's flower is...

dialogues.jp: 「さくら、悪ィ。また今度な」
dialogues.en: "Sakura, sorry, I'd see you next time."
dialogues.text: "Sakura, sorry, I'd see you next time."

dialogues.speaker: Sakura
dialogues.jp: 「え、お兄ちゃん、どこいくの？」
dialogues.en: "Ehh, onii-chan, where're you going?"
dialogues.text: "Ehh, onii-chan, where're you going?"

dialogues.speaker: Sakura
dialogues.jp: 「そのロスキルラベンダーのところだよ！」
dialogues.en: "To the Roskill Lavender!"
dialogues.text: "To the Roskill Lavender!"

dialogues.speaker: Sakura
dialogues.jp: 「そ、そんなに急がなくても」
dialogues.en: "T, there's no need to be in such a hurry!"
dialogues.text: "T, there's no need to be in such a hurry!"

dialogues.speaker: Sakura
dialogues.jp: 「超特急だ！」
dialogues.en: "You're right! I should be faster!"
dialogues.text: "You're right! I should be faster!"

dialogues.jp:
俺は、さくらの肩をポンと叩いて、学校へ逆戻
りする。
dialogues.en:
With a quick pat on the shoulder, I ran back towards the
direction of the school.
dialogues.text:
With a quick pat on the shoulder, I ran back towards the
direction of the school.

dialogues.speaker: Alice
dialogues.jp: 「……朝倉、先輩？」
dialogues.en: "...Asakura, senpai?"
dialogues.text: "...Asakura, senpai?"

dialogues.speaker: Alice
dialogues.jp: 「アリス、急いで来てくれ！」
dialogues.en: "Alice, come with me!"
dialogues.text: "Alice, come with me!"

dialogues.speaker: Alice
dialogues.jp: 「え、どこへ……」
dialogues.en: "Eh, where...?"
dialogues.text: "Eh, where...?"

dialogues.speaker: Alice
dialogues.jp: 「いいから、ついて来て！」
dialogues.en: "Just hurry up and follow me!"
dialogues.text: "Just hurry up and follow me!"

dialogues.jp:
俺は、アリスの細い腕を掴み、体育館裏に直行
する。
dialogues.en:
I grabbed Alice's slender hand, and rushed off towards the
back of the gym.
dialogues.text:
I grabbed Alice's slender hand, and rushed off towards the
back of the gym.

dialogues.jp:
「あのな、実はロスキルラベンダー、残ってた
　んだよ」
dialogues.en: "Apparently, there's still a Roskill Lavender left there!"
dialogues.text: "Apparently, there's still a Roskill Lavender left there!"

dialogues.speaker: Alice
dialogues.jp: 「ロスキルラベンダーが？」
dialogues.en: "A Roskill Lavender?
dialogues.text: "A Roskill Lavender?

dialogues.speaker: Alice
dialogues.jp:
「ああ。さくらってヤツが、嵐の前にこっそり
　抜いてたらしいんだ。それで、その後にまた
　戻しておいたらしいんだよ」
dialogues.en:
"Yeah. That Sakura took one of the stalks with her before
the storm, and only returned it after."
dialogues.text:
"Yeah. That Sakura took one of the stalks with her before
the storm, and only returned it after."

dialogues.speaker: Alice
dialogues.jp: 「知らなかった……」
dialogues.en: "I didn't know..."
dialogues.text: "I didn't know..."

dialogues.jp:
あの日以来、俺もアリスもここに訪れたことは
なかった。
dialogues.en: After that day, neither Alice nor I ever visited that place.
dialogues.text: After that day, neither Alice nor I ever visited that place.

dialogues.jp:
花がダメになった後は、来る理由もなかったし、
花のことを思い出すのも、はばかられていたか
らだった。
dialogues.en:
Not only was there no reason to go there without the flower,
but it would've only brought back bad memories.
dialogues.text:
Not only was there no reason to go there without the flower,
but it would've only brought back bad memories.

dialogues.speaker: Alice
dialogues.jp: 「……朝倉、先輩。あれ……」
dialogues.en: "...Asakura, senpai. That's..."
dialogues.text: "...Asakura, senpai. That's..."

dialogues.speaker: Alice
dialogues.jp: 「……ロスキルラベンダー」
dialogues.en: "...Roskill Lavender."
dialogues.text: "...Roskill Lavender."

dialogues.speaker: Alice
dialogues.jp: 「花が咲いてる……」
dialogues.en: "It's blooming..."
dialogues.text: "It's blooming..."

dialogues.speaker: Alice
dialogues.jp: 「ロスキルラベンダーの花が咲いてる」
dialogues.en: "The Roskill Lavender bloomed."
dialogues.text: "The Roskill Lavender bloomed."

dialogues.speaker: Alice
dialogues.jp: 「日本じゃ絶対に咲かないって言われてたのに」
dialogues.en: "And it was said that it couldn't possibly grow in Japan..."
dialogues.text: "And it was said that it couldn't possibly grow in Japan..."

dialogues.jp:
そこには、健気に花をつけたロスキルラベンダー
が｛つつ／慎｝ましく｛たたず／佇｝んでいた。
dialogues.en:
The Roskill Lavender was sporting a flower, standing upright
and proud.
dialogues.text:
The Roskill Lavender was sporting a flower, standing upright
and proud.

dialogues.speaker: Alice
dialogues.jp: 「……きれい」
dialogues.en: "...Beautiful."
dialogues.text: "...Beautiful."

dialogues.speaker: Alice
dialogues.jp: 「……きれいだな」
dialogues.en: "...It's so beautiful."
dialogues.text: "...It's so beautiful."

dialogues.jp: 北欧の寒い地域に咲く、小さな花。
dialogues.en:
A tiny flower that was supposed to only grow in cold
climates, in Scandinavian countries.
dialogues.text:
A tiny flower that was supposed to only grow in cold
climates, in Scandinavian countries.

dialogues.jp:
わずかな時間しか開花することのない花に願い
をかければ、叶うと言われている不思議な花。
dialogues.en:
The flower which, in the short time it blooms, was said to
be able to grant wishes.
dialogues.text:
The flower which, in the short time it blooms, was said to
be able to grant wishes.

dialogues.jp: 日本では、咲かないと言われた花。
dialogues.en: The flower that was said to not be able to grow in Japan.
dialogues.text: The flower that was said to not be able to grow in Japan.

dialogues.jp: それが、今、目の前に咲いていた……。
dialogues.en: That flower was in front of me right now...
dialogues.text: That flower was in front of me right now...

dialogues.jp:
小さな花びらを、春のそよ風になびかせながら、
それは咲いていた。
dialogues.en: The small flower, swaying with the gentle spring wind.
dialogues.text: The small flower, swaying with the gentle spring wind.

dialogues.jp: 「願い、かけなきゃ」
dialogues.en: "...We can make a wish."
dialogues.text: "...We can make a wish."

dialogues.jp:
本当に叶うかどうか知らないけれど、こんな奇
跡またとない。
dialogues.en:
Who knows whether it'd really come true, but if miracles
like this can happen...
dialogues.text:
Who knows whether it'd really come true, but if miracles
like this can happen...

dialogues.jp: 俺は、何か願い事を探す。
dialogues.en: I tried to think of something to wish for.
dialogues.text: I tried to think of something to wish for.

dialogues.speaker: Alice
dialogues.en: "...Senpai."
dialogues.text: "...Senpai."

dialogues.speaker: Alice
dialogues.jp: 「なんだ？」
dialogues.en: "Huh?"
dialogues.text: "Huh?"

dialogues.speaker: Alice
dialogues.jp: 「違うと思う」
dialogues.en: "I think that's a bit off."
dialogues.text: "I think that's a bit off."

dialogues.speaker: Alice
dialogues.jp: 「違う？」
dialogues.en: "It is?"
dialogues.text: "It is?"

dialogues.jp: こくんと頷くアリス。
dialogues.en: She nodded.
dialogues.text: She nodded.

dialogues.speaker: Alice
dialogues.jp:
「この花、……ロスキルラベンダーは、短い間
　に咲いた花に願いをかけるんじゃなくて」
dialogues.en:
"This flower... the Roskill Lavender, I don't think it
grants wishes in the short time that it blooms."
dialogues.text:
"This flower... the Roskill Lavender, I don't think it
grants wishes in the short time that it blooms."

dialogues.speaker: Alice
dialogues.jp:
「願いが叶った時に、花を咲かせるんじゃない
　かなって」
dialogues.en: "Instead, it only blooms after your wish has been granted."
dialogues.text: "Instead, it only blooms after your wish has been granted."

dialogues.speaker: Alice
dialogues.jp: 「アリスの願い……」
dialogues.en: "Alice's wish..."
dialogues.text: "Alice's wish..."

dialogues.speaker: Alice
dialogues.jp:
「そう……。お友達がほしいっていう、私の願
　い」
dialogues.en: "Yes... my wish, to have friends."
dialogues.text: "Yes... my wish, to have friends."

dialogues.jp:
アリスは、ロスキルラベンダーの花をゆっくり
と触った。
dialogues.en:
Alice gently and slowly brushed the Roskill Lavender with
her hand.
dialogues.text:
Alice gently and slowly brushed the Roskill Lavender with
her hand.

dialogues.speaker: Alice
dialogues.jp:
「私の願い、叶いました……。とっても素敵な
　お友達が、たくさんできました」
dialogues.en:
"My wish came true... I managed to make lots of wonderful
friends."
dialogues.text:
"My wish came true... I managed to make lots of wonderful
friends."

dialogues.speaker: Alice
dialogues.jp: 「それに、素敵な恋人もできました」
dialogues.en: "And a wonderful lover, as well."
dialogues.text: "And a wonderful lover, as well."

dialogues.jp: ──コホン。なんだか照れるな。
dialogues.en: --cough. That was kinda embarassing.
dialogues.text: --cough. That was kinda embarassing.

dialogues.speaker: Alice
dialogues.jp:
「ありがとう。咲いてくれて、ありがとう。私
　の願いを｛・・・／聞いて｝くれて、ありがとう」
dialogues.en:
"Thank you. Thank you for blooming. Thank you for listening
to my wish."
dialogues.text:
"Thank you. Thank you for blooming. Thank you for listening
to my wish."

dialogues.jp: 俺は、アリスの肩をきゅっと抱きしめる。
dialogues.en: I hugged Alice's shoulders tightly.
dialogues.text: I hugged Alice's shoulders tightly.

dialogues.jp: 小さくて｛きゃしゃ／華奢｝な身体を、きゅっと抱きしめる。
dialogues.en: Tightly hugging that slender body of hers.
dialogues.text: Tightly hugging that slender body of hers.

dialogues.speaker: Alice
dialogues.jp: 「また、来年……会いましょう」
dialogues.en: "Next year... we'd see you again."
dialogues.text: "Next year... we'd see you again."

dialogues.jp:
ロスキルラベンダーの花びらがゆっくりと閉じ
ていく。
dialogues.en: The Roskill Lavender's petals slowly started to close up.
dialogues.text: The Roskill Lavender's petals slowly started to close up.

dialogues.jp: 咲いている期間が終わったらしい。
dialogues.en: Seems it's blooming period just expired.
dialogues.text: Seems it's blooming period just expired.

dialogues.jp:
俺は、ロスキルラベンダーの花に、たった一つ、
願いをかけておいた。
dialogues.en: I ended up making a wish to it.
dialogues.text: I ended up making a wish to it.

dialogues.jp: 『アリスといつまでも一緒にいられますように』
dialogues.en: "I want to be together with Alice, always."
dialogues.text: "I want to be together with Alice, always."

dialogues.speaker: Alice
dialogues.jp: 「──ありがとう」
dialogues.en: "--Thank you."
dialogues.text: "--Thank you."

dialogues.jp:
誰に向けてかわからないけれど、アリスはそう
呟いた。
dialogues.en: She whispered, lost to the light spring breeze.
dialogues.text: She whispered, lost to the light spring breeze.

dialogues.jp: ◆ＥＤ・いつまでも……◆
dialogues.en: ◆ED. Always...◆
dialogues.text: ◆ED. Always...◆

dialogues.jp:
公園を歩いていると、久しぶりにさくらに出会
う。
dialogues.en:
Walking through the park, I met someone I hadn't seen in
awhile; Sakura.
dialogues.text:
Walking through the park, I met someone I hadn't seen in
awhile; Sakura.

dialogues.jp:
彼女は、用事があってしばらく姿を見せなかっ
たのだといい、そして、またしばらくは会えな
いのだという。
dialogues.en:
She had left to take care of something suddenly before, and
after this, wouldn't be coming back for awhile again.
dialogues.text:
She had left to take care of something suddenly before, and
after this, wouldn't be coming back for awhile again.

dialogues.jp: ただ、さくらが気になることを言っていた。
dialogues.en: But, Sakura had something she wanted to ask me.
dialogues.text: But, Sakura had something she wanted to ask me.

dialogues.jp: ロスキルラベンダーの花はどうなったのか、と。
dialogues.en: That is, how the Roskill Lavender was doing.
dialogues.text: That is, how the Roskill Lavender was doing.

dialogues.jp:
ダメになったはずの花。よくよく話を聞いてみ
ると、あの嵐の前、さくらが研究のため、１度
抜いてしまった株があったのだという。
dialogues.en:
It was a flower that should've had no hope left. After some
conversation, I found out she had taken a stalk before the
storm, to research.
dialogues.text:
It was a flower that should've had no hope left. After some
conversation, I found out she had taken a stalk before the
storm, to research.

dialogues.jp:
俺は、さくらと別れ、アリスを捜しに行く。そ
して、彼女の手をひっぱり、体育館の裏へ赴く。
dialogues.en:
I left Sakura behind, and went to look for Alice. I took her
by the hand, and dashed off to behind the gym.
dialogues.text:
I left Sakura behind, and went to look for Alice. I took her
by the hand, and dashed off to behind the gym.

dialogues.jp:
そこには──、見事な花を咲かせているロスキ
ルラベンダーがあった。
dialogues.en:
Standing proudly, there-- a beautiful flower of the Roskill
Lavender.
dialogues.text:
Standing proudly, there-- a beautiful flower of the Roskill
Lavender.

dialogues.jp:
アリスは言う。この花は、願いをかける花では
なく、願いを叶えたときこそ、花を咲かせるの
ではないかと……。
dialogues.en:
According to Alice, it doesn't actually grant wishes when it
blooms, but instead, blooms when wishes are granted.
dialogues.text:
According to Alice, it doesn't actually grant wishes when it
blooms, but instead, blooms when wishes are granted.

dialogues.jp:
けれど、俺はロスキルラベンダーの花に願いを
かける。
dialogues.en:
Despite that, I still offered my wish to the Roskill
Lavender.
dialogues.text:
Despite that, I still offered my wish to the Roskill
Lavender.

dialogues.jp: 『アリスといつまでも一緒にいられますように』
dialogues.en: "I want to be together with Alice, always."
dialogues.text: "I want to be together with Alice, always."
